angle.name: Tired Traveler
angle.why: Away team on the 2nd night of a back-to-back AND it crossed a time zone since its last game (home team rested): bet the home team
angle.backtest: 178-143 (55.5%) at the morning line 2020-21..2025-26, every season 51%+; found after trying 6 versions (honest ~54.5%). Star level set by choice for tracking
